comment: Strengths: The REDDHI concept is the strongest contribution in the document. Framing resilience and essential data infrastructure as a foundational baseline rather than an aspirational goal is exactly the right approach for low and middle income settings, and naming it clearly gives countries and development partners a shared reference point for investment conversations. The mapping of health goals to architecture components is also genuinely useful — it connects technical design decisions to health outcomes in a way that non-technical stakeholders including ministries and donors can engage with. The governance section is more thorough than most comparable guidance documents and reflects hard-won lessons from real implementations.
